meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: 装上后，遇到多步骤任务时 Claude 会先做文档调研，再按阶段输出可实施计划；每阶段写清楚要做什么、参考哪里、如何验证完成。
howto.when: 当你要求为功能、任务或多步骤实现做计划时触发，通常发生在让它实际动手执行之前。

say.text: 帮我规划实现这个功能，先别写代码。
say.note: 触发文档调研并生成分阶段计划。

say.text: 把数据库迁移拆成多阶段计划，每阶段写清验证方法。
say.note: 得到带检查清单的分阶段方案。

say.text: 为这次重构做一个参考文档的分阶段方案，列出要避开的坑。
say.note: 返回含文档引用和反模式提醒的计划。

howto.what_en: When installed, for a multi-step task Claude first scans relevant docs/examples, then produces a phased plan. Each stage says what to build, which docs to follow, and how to verify completion.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation, typically before asking Claude to execute with do.

say_en.text: Plan how to build this feature, but don't write code yet.
say_en.note: Triggers doc discovery and a phased plan.

say_en.text: Break the DB migration into phases with a verification checklist per phase.
say_en.note: You'll get a phased plan with checks.

say_en.text: Make a doc-backed plan for this refactor and list pitfalls to avoid.
say_en.note: Returns a plan with doc references and anti-pattern guards.
